title: The weather today
instructions: Kısa bir hava durumu anonsu. Sabah ve öğleden sonrayı ayırt et.

script.speaker: kate
script.text: Good morning! Here is the weather for today.

script.speaker: kate
script.text: It is cold and windy in the morning.

script.speaker: kate
script.text: In the afternoon, it is sunny and warm.

script.speaker: kate
script.text: It is not rainy today, so you don't need an umbrella.

questions.prompt: What is the weather like in the morning?
questions.feedback: Sabah soğuk ve rüzgârlı (cold and windy). Güneşli ve sıcak olan öğleden sonra.
questions.evidence: It is cold and windy in the morning.

questions.prompt: What is the weather like in the afternoon?
questions.feedback: Öğleden sonra (in the afternoon) güneşli ve ılık.
questions.evidence: In the afternoon, it is sunny and warm.

questions.prompt: What does Kate tell you to take?
questions.feedback: Bugün yağmur yok, şemsiyeye gerek yok (don't need an umbrella). Güneş gözlüğünü al diyor.
